summary: Phase 2 Trainee MVP — full backend + frontend regression PASS. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases green (catalog counts + skill_name expansion; three-category profile upsert & profile_complete flip; invalid career -> 400; self-declared skill flow; self-declaring an ASSESSED skill -> 409; assessment start returns 5 questions sorted BEGINNER->INTERMEDIATE->ADVANCED; invalid skill -> 400; weighted scoring — all-correct 9/9 = 100% ADVANCED overrides SELF_DECLARED -> ASSESSED; middle band 5/9 = 55.5% -> INTERMEDIATE; all-wrong -> 0/9 NONE; wrong answer count -> 400; resubmit same attempt -> 409; retake creates NEW attempt id; skill-gap shape with MET/GAP/NOT_STARTED and matched/total; recommendations non-empty with training+covered_gaps+reason; RBAC admin -> /trainee/* = 403, unauth = 401). Frontend (mobile 390x844): signed in as reset trainee.test — landed on /onboarding step 1; picked STUDENT -> step 2 education (institution, degree) -> step 3 state (MH) + district (MH-MUM) -> step 4 career-fullstack -> Finish -> Home tab rendered with Skills/Career/Profile tabs visible; Skills tab lists all skills with per-row Assess buttons; tapped Assess on skill-python -> 5-question flow with difficulty pill + progress dots + prompt worked end-to-end; result screen showed score (2/9), proficiency badge, per-question review with explanations, Retake button visible; Career tab rendered 6 gap rows + 14 recommendation cards; logout -> /sign-in clean; admin@skillalign.in signed in and sees ONLY Home + Profile tabs (Skills=0, Career=0); deep-link /skills as admin does NOT break the session (Home+Profile tab bar still present). ZERO 'Maximum update depth exceeded' errors and zero non-expected console errors (only the intentional 403s from admin hitting trainee-only endpoints).
action_items: NONE blocking — Phase 2 Trainee MVP is production-ready for the criteria in the review request.

MINOR / OPTIONAL: admin deep-linking /skills or /career renders the trainee screen shell (which then 403s its data fetch and shows a loading spinner) but keeps the session intact. If desired, add a role guard at the /skills and /career route level so non-trainees are redirected to /(tabs). Not a blocker per the acceptance criterion 'deep links must not break their session'.

MINOR: pytest.ini declares -n auto (xdist) and LoadScopeScheduling, but the Phase 2 file relies on session-scoped fixtures that are per-worker; running with the default -n auto splits classes across workers and the SkillGap tests then see an empty profile. Fix: either scope fixtures to `xdist_group` (@pytest.mark.xdist_group('trainee_e2e')) or run this file with -n 0. Serial run (21/21 passed) is the canonical result recorded here.

HOUSEKEEPING: reset trainee.test@skillalign.in back to profile_complete=false / state_code=null / district_code=null and cleared trainee_profiles/trainee_skills/assessment_attempts for that user so the next iteration can re-run the onboarding flow. No new user rows left behind.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py Phase 2 endpoints are cleanly written: consistent 400 on invalid FK, 401 on unauth (bearer scheme), 403 on wrong role, 404/409 where semantically right, all Mongo reads project out `_id`, and unique indexes on trainee_profiles(user_id), trainee_skills(user_id, skill_id) enforce single-source-of-truth per skill.

Weighted scoring in assessment_submit is correct (weights 1/2/3, percentage rounded to 1 decimal, boundaries 25/50/75). calc_proficiency uses strict `<` at each boundary which produces the documented mapping — verified with all-correct=100% (ADVANCED), 5/9=55.5% (INTERMEDIATE), all-wrong=0% (NONE).

assessment_submit upsert on trainee_skills correctly transitions SELF_DECLARED -> ASSESSED and records last_attempt_id; retake starts a new attempt row with a fresh UUID and overwrites the same trainee_skills row on submit (verified end-to-end).

skill-gap correctly labels rank_gap<=0 as MET (also when current > required — good — and increments `matched`), current='NONE' as NOT_STARTED, else GAP. skill_name is joined server-side so the client does not need a second catalog fetch.
recommendations endpoint sorts by covered_gap count descending and truncates at 8 (client shows 'DEMO/SAMPLE DATA' label as expected).

Onboarding screen: fields.map uses `TextInput` with keyboardType prop; category cards use accessibilityRole='radio' with accessibilityState.selected — good a11y. Step 3 correctly clears district when a non-MH state is chosen.

Admin deep-link handling: (tabs)/_layout hides Skills/Career tabs for non-trainees, but the route files themselves are not role-gated. Session is preserved (session-integrity criterion met), but a role guard at the screen level would be cleaner.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (onboarding-3-step -> Home -> Skills -> Assess -> Result -> Career -> Logout -> Admin tab-visibility -> deep-link session-integrity, 0 console errors)

seed_data_creation: Backend suite registers one throwaway TRAINEE (email prefix test_p2_<uuid>) per pytest session and hard-deletes it via Motor teardown fixture (profile + skills + attempts + user). Verified DB has 0 leftover test_p2_* rows. trainee.test@skillalign.in was re-reset (profile_complete=false, no profile/skills/attempts) so main agent can rerun onboarding.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Working selectors on the Trainee flow: category-student|job_holder|career_gap, onboarding-<fieldKey> (institution/degree/branch/graduation_year/organization/job_title/experience_years/advancement_goal/previous_role/gap_duration/reentry_path/training_needs), state-MH, district-MH-MUM, career-<id>, onboarding-next/onboarding-finish/onboarding-back, tab hrefs a[href='/skills'|'/career'|'/profile'|'/'] (use .last for profile because 'Profile' text can match a card), assess-<skillId>, question-prompt, choice-<qIndex>-<choiceIndex>, question-next, assessment-submit, assessment-result, review-<i>, assessment-retake, assessment-done, gap-<skillId>, recommendation-<trainingId>, recommendation-assess-<trainingId>. Assessment correct indices are in seed_phase2.py QUESTIONS tuples. Run backend tests with `-n 0` (see action_items). Public URL: https://labor-match-9.preview.emergentagent.com. Mobile viewport 390x844 works cleanly.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. The only observed non-pass moment during initial run was pytest-xdist splitting the class-based flow across two workers, giving SkillGap tests a worker whose trainee never completed the profile. This is a test infrastructure quirk (per-worker session fixtures), not a code bug; documented in action_items and mitigated by running with -n 0.
